view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse interior with high ceilings and concrete floors. Dominant red metal shelving units fill the background, stocked with boxes and pallets. An orange forklift is partially visible on the right. A person walks in the left distance near blue racks. The image has motion blur, suggesting movement.

objects.label: red metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall, multi-tiered red metal shelves occupying the center and left background, filled with cardboard boxes and labeled items. They stand on the concrete floor, supported by vertical posts. Some shelves have white labels. Partially obscured by other objects.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: Orange and gray forklift positioned on the right side, partially cut off by the frame. Its operator's seat and control panel are visible. It appears to be stationary or moving slowly. Blurred due to motion.

objects.label: person walking
objects.observation: A person in dark clothing walking from left to right in the far background, near blue racks. Their motion causes slight blur. They are distant and partially obscured by equipment.

objects.label: stacked red plastic crates
objects.observation: Four red plastic crates stacked vertically on a wooden pallet, located in the mid-ground near the center. They sit on the concrete floor. No visible labels or markings.

objects.label: blue metal racks
objects.observation: Blue metal racks located on the far left, behind the walking person. They appear to hold some items but are mostly empty or obscured. Mounted against the wall.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Several wooden pallets scattered throughout the scene. One holds red crates, another holds cardboard boxes, and others are empty. All rest directly on the concrete floor.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Multiple cardboard boxes of various sizes stored on shelves and on pallets. Some are stacked neatly, others are loose. Located across the entire scene, primarily on shelves and pallets.

objects.label: blue barrel
objects.observation: A single blue barrel standing upright on a wooden pallet near the right foreground. It is cylindrical and appears to contain liquid or bulk material. Partially obscured by the forklift.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s3-36540", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
